findings.description: skills/work-planner/artifacts/acceptance-criteria.md:79,85 specified Run at Revision under sbx, where git worktree add cannot write the repository's git directory (reproduced exit 2). Fixed: the command runs outside sbx and the instrument carries its own sbx prefix.

skills/work-planner/artifacts/pull-request.md:35-37 Access Development Links ran Capture Pull Request Links with a record nothing supplied. Fixed: step 1 runs Read Pull Request State first, whose Save Pull Request Snapshot is the full REST object carrying html_url.

skills/work-planner/scripts/development.py:75-81 reported a gh call refused outright (401) as every subject 'not returned'. Fixed: a nonzero exit without GraphQL errors, or non-object JSON, exits 'GraphQL read failed:' with gh's message; GraphQL errors still return for per-subject naming; both capture specs document it.

AC8's draft pull request on a non-default branch was not exercised by test_development_link.py. Fixed: Live test asserts draft and non-default base and two adds holding the link once from both ends; its passing run is recorded in the fix validation.

skills/work-planner/SKILL.md:91 states scripts run under sbx and only a script that reads the tracker runs outside it, but revision-check.py (acceptance-criteria.md:76-79) now runs outside sbx for a different reason: it registers a worktree in the repository's git directory. The skill-level rule contradicts that command. Fix: generalise the SKILL.md sentence to scripts that reach the tracker or write a repository's git directory, so the rule covers both.
